title: Waiver of rights.
bodyText: The failure of an injured person to comply with all of the provisions of this chapter relating to the contractors recovery fund shall constitute a waiver of any right hereunder.
bodyHtml: §444-33  Waiver of rights.  The failure of an injured person to comply with all of the provisions of this chapter relating to the contractors recovery fund shall constitute a waiver of any right hereunder. [L 1973, c 170, pt of §1; am L 1977, c 127, §4]
